card.name: Letter b or degree sign after number
card.fires_on: The small symbol or letter right after a number: the letter b in labels like 1b, or a Fahrenheit/Celsius sign (℉, ℃) or cent sign after digits.

modes.description: The letter b right after the number 1 in figure, genotype, list or haplogroup labels.

modes.label: Temperature sign
modes.description: A single-character degree symbol such as ℉ right after a temperature number in storage text.
